translation: It grows at 長子 and Mount Tai and Linzi; gather without a fixed time. Original text of the Benjing: Long-stone (長石), flavor pungent, cold. It chiefly treats body heat and cold cyanotic extremities (寒厥) of the four limbs, benefits urination, courses the blood vessels, brightens the eyes and removes film [over the eyes], and down-drives the three worms.
